headline: Marymount (Va.) leads the AEC at both ends
dek: Marymount (Va.) has scored 60 goals while allowing just fourteen, outscoring Gwynedd Mercy, Centenary (N.J.), and Saint Elizabeth combined. That defensive margin carried the program to thirteen wins and two draws against five losses, leaving it unbeaten in conference play.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The conference breaks cleanly into upper and lower halves, with Immaculata's 50 goals—the smallest total in the top half—still outscoring Gwynedd Mercy, Centenary (N.J.), and Saint Elizabeth combined.

wire.line: Saint Elizabeth has yet to score across thirteen losses, conceding 110 goals without a win or a draw.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Centenary (N.J.) accounts for the conference's one match past its date with no published result, an August meeting with Rutgers-Newark.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Pratt Institute senior Emma Pratt leads the AEC in scoring with eighteen goals on 83 shots, while also contributing seven assists.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Gwynedd Mercy goalkeeper Zoe Davis has made 113 saves against 43 goals conceded, posting a 0.724 save percentage.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Immaculata has spread its 50 goals across fifteen distinct scorers this season.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Marymount (Va.) freshman Eleanor Keough leads the conference in shot volume with 87 attempts, scoring fifteen goals and assisting on seven.

last_match.line: Marymount (Va.) closed its season unbeaten since early October after sweeping conference play.
